== The Marvelous Land of Oz ==

=== Infobox ===

* Name: Gump
* Type: Flying machine
* Status: Active

The Gump is a flying construct assembled atop the palace roof from the head of a Gump mounted with antlers, two sofas bound together as a body, and four palm-tree leaves cut by the Tin Woodman and attached as wings, held together with ropes and a broom. Once brought to life, it could speak, obey commands, and fly by waving its four wings, carrying Tip, the Scarecrow, the Tin Woodman, Jack Pumpkinhead, the Woggle-Bug, and the Saw-Horse south in search of Glinda the Good.
</div>

== Events ==

* Assembled on the palace roof and brought to life; obeyed Tip's command to return and landed safely.
* Carried the group south through the night toward Glinda the Good, flying beyond the Land of Oz into unfamiliar territory.
* Misjudged its landing speed, broke both right wings against a cliff edge, and tumbled down before catching on a projecting rock.
* Its nest on the cliff was attacked by jackdaws, fought off by the Tin Woodman and the Saw-Horse.
* Had its broken wings mended by the Woggle-Bug's wish, restoring full flight.
